title: Probing protoplanetary disk evolution in the Chamaeleon II region
question: How do disk dust masses in Cha II compare with other 1-10 Myr star-forming regions, as a probe of disk evolution?

what.value: Stellar luminosities and temperatures for Cha II

evidence.quote: We used the luminosities determined by (cite: Spezzi_2008), rescaled to the *Gaia* distances.

what.value: Millimeter fluxes of comparison regions (Upper Sco, CrA, IC 348, Cha I, Lupus, Taurus)

evidence.quote: We also recalculated dust masses in a homogeneous way from millimeter or submillimetrer fluxes (cite: Barenfeld_2016; Cazzoletti_2019; Ruiz-Rodriguez_2018; Pascucci_2016; Ansdell_2016; ansdell_2018; Andrews_2013)

external_data.citation: (cite: Barenfeld_2016; Cazzoletti_2019; Ruiz-Rodriguez_2018; Pascucci_2016; Ansdell_2016; Andrews_2013)

evidence.quote: we report the individual distances as estimated by (cite: Galli_2020b)

recipe.method: Elliptical Gaussian fit to visibilities; point source if size/uncertainty<5
Integrate line profiles over channels with >3 sigma; upper limits 3 RMS over 6.3 km/s

key_parameters: kappa=2.3 cm2/g at 230 GHz; Tdust=25K(L/Lsun)^1/4; 20 K if no luminosity
assumptions: Optically thin emission; individual Gaia distances, else 198 pc

recipe.goal: Homogeneous stellar masses for all regions
recipe.method: Likelihood on Baraffe 2015 isochrone grid, marginalized for median and percentiles
key_parameters: sigma log L=0.1, sigma log T=0.02; 0.05-1.4 Msun in 0.01 steps

recipe.method: Kaplan-Meier estimator for Mdust and Mdust/Mstar
Logrank test on Mdust/Mstar; logrank on Mdust in 5 stellar mass bins with 10^4 resamplings

evidence.quote: we detect 22 sources in the continuum, 10 in $^{12}$CO, 3 in $^{13}$CO, and none in C$^{18}$O (J=2-1)
we derive a median dust mass of $4.5 \pm 1.5$ M$_\oplus$ from survival analysis

answer_key.quantity: Median p-values in mass-bin test vs Cha II
answer_key.value: Taurus 0.22, Lupus b6 0.40, Lupus b7 0.31, Cha I 0.47, IC 348 0.54, CrA 0.08, Upper Sco 0.56

evidence.quote: We find median $p_\phi$ values of 0.22, 0.40, 0.31, 0.47, 0.54, 0.08, and 0.56

not_stated_but_needed: Continuum and line-free channel ranges for continuum imaging and uvcontsub
Image size, cell size, clean threshold, masks and number of iterations
Random binning/draw details for 10^4 Monte Carlo logrank test
Final stellar parameter tables for comparison regions
missing_for_reproduction: Random seed and binning for Monte Carlo test
score_reason: Single public dataset and clear dust mass recipe, but imaging details and comparison-sample inputs are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, explicit uvmodelfit and mass formulas, numeric tabulated results.
